# Prep

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(rtracklayer)
library(tidyverse)
library(DiffBind)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}

# Read data -------------------------------------------------------------
cistrome_files <- list(
  E2_noE2      = "noE2_E2_bg_rpkm_not_dm6_sacCer3.bed_result.csv",
  sgER_sgC     = "sgER_sgControl_bg_rpkm_not_dm6_sacCer3.bed_result.csv",
  sgControl_E2 = "sgControl_E2_bg_rpkm_not_dm6_sacCer3.bed_result.csv",
  sgER_E2      = "sgER_E2_bg_rpkm_not_dm6_sacCer3.bed_result.csv"
)

cistrome_data <- lapply(cistrome_files, read_csv)

# Plot titles (adjust the comparison wording if needed) ---------------------
cistrome_titles <- c(
  E2_noE2      = "E2 vs noE2 (Cistrome Toolkit)",
  sgER_sgC     = "sgER vs sgControl (Cistrome Toolkit)",
  sgControl_E2 = "sgControl E2 (Cistrome Toolkit)",
  sgER_E2      = "sgER E2 (Cistrome Toolkit)"
)

```

```{r}
# Plot function (unchanged) -----------------------------------------------
plot_top_cistrome <- function(df, title, n_top = 5, top_factor = "ESR1") {

  top_factors <- df %>%
    group_by(Factor) %>%
    summarise(max_score = max(GIGGLE_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(max_score, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    pull(Factor)

  # Make sure ESR1 is plotted even if it isn't in the top n by score
  top_factors <- union(top_factors, top_factor)

  # Order remaining factors by max score (ascending, so highest is nearest the top),
  # then append ESR1 last so it sits at the very top of the y-axis
  factor_order <- df %>%
    filter(Factor %in% top_factors, Factor != top_factor) %>%
    group_by(Factor) %>%
    summarise(max_score = max(GIGGLE_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(max_score) %>%
    pull(Factor) %>%
    as.character()

  df_top <- df %>%
    filter(Factor %in% top_factors) %>%
    mutate(Factor = factor(Factor, levels = c(factor_order, top_factor)))

  ggplot(df_top, aes(x = GIGGLE_score, y = Factor)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = Factor), shape = 21, colour = "black",
                height = 0.2, width = 0, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.7,
                show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title,
         x     = "GIGGLE score",
         y     = "Factor") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
}
```


```{r}
# Build all four plots, then write one PDF per plot --------------------------
cistrome_plots <- Map(plot_top_cistrome,
                      df    = cistrome_data,
                      title = cistrome_titles[names(cistrome_data)])

for (nm in names(cistrome_plots)) {
  pdf(paste0(nm, "_cistrome_plot.pdf"), width = 4, height = 2)
  print(cistrome_plots[[nm]])   # print() is needed inside a loop
  dev.off()
}

# View individually in the notebook
cistrome_plots$E2_noE2
cistrome_plots$sgER_sgC
cistrome_plots$sgControl_E2
cistrome_plots$sgER_E2

```
